hero.subtitle: Unleash the Fighter Within
hero.description: Bhadrachalam's premier combat sports academy. Master Mixed Martial Arts, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, Boxing, and practical Self-Defense with expert coaches.

cards.title: Professional MMA Coaching
cards.text: At Grip MMA, we offer world-class coaching in Mixed Martial Arts. Our structured programs combine striking, wrestling, and submission grappling to build complete combat readiness. Whether you are training for a competition, looking to learn self-defense, or wanting an intense physical workout, our expert trainers design sessions that push your limits safely and progressively.

cards.title: Elite Grappling & BJJ
cards.text: Master the art of leverage, control, and submission with our dedicated Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) and wrestling programs. Learn how to defend yourself from the ground, execute sweeps, and apply joint locks and chokeholds. BJJ builds incredible core strength, flexibility, mental toughness, and tactical problem-solving under pressure.

cards.title: Striking & Stand-up Arts
cards.text: Develop explosive power, hand-eye coordination, and fluid movement through boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai, and traditional karate. We focus on perfect striking technique, defense, footwork, and conditioning. Our striking classes are great for building rapid cardiovascular fitness, reflexes, and raw hitting power.

services.title: Disciplines
services.description: Discover the range of martial arts and combat disciplines we coach at Grip MMA. Our programs are designed to accommodate absolute beginners as well as seasoned fighters, with a primary focus on safety, form, and skill progression.

accordion.title: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
accordion.description: Our MMA classes integrate striking, takedowns, wall work, and ground fighting into a cohesive system. You'll learn how to transition seamlessly between stand-up fighting, clinch wrestling, and ground grappling, mimicking the demands of modern combat sports.

accordion.title: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Wrestling
accordion.description: Focusing on the grappling aspect of combat. We train both Gi and No-Gi BJJ along with freestyle wrestling takedowns. Learn to control opponents, defend against submissions, and secure tapouts using technique and leverage over raw size and strength.

accordion.title: Striking (Boxing & Kickboxing)
accordion.description: A high-intensity program covering punches, kicks, knees, and elbow strikes. Our classes combine pad work, heavy bag drills, and controlled sparring to build cardiovascular endurance, punching power, and defensive head movement.

accordion.title: Self-Defense & Traditional Arts
accordion.description: Practical self-defense courses drawing on Karate, Taekwondo, and Krav Maga. Learn situational awareness, threat de-escalation, strike evasion, and escape techniques designed for real-world scenarios to build confidence and personal safety.

classes_section.title: Combat Classes
classes_section.description: Review our core combat training classes led by Coach Arshad. Select a program that aligns with your goals and start building your skills today.

cards.title: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)

cards.title: Self-Defense & Karate

cards.description: Traditional Karate forms, kata, and modern practical self-defense. Learn hand strikes, blocks, kicks, and escape maneuvers. 60 minutes.

schedule_section.title: Training Timetable
schedule_section.description: Our schedule features dedicated MMA arts training sessions led by Coach Arshad. Morning sessions run from 5:30 AM to 7:00 AM, and evening sessions run from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Sunday is a rest day.
